title: How long should you REALLY rest between sets? ⏱️
caption:
Short rests feel productive, but in trained men 3-minute rests built more strength and muscle than 1-minute rests. Rest long enough to hit your reps again: 2-3 minutes for big lifts. How long do you rest? 👇

Muscle Building, Part 11
first_comment: 60 seconds rest gang, you are lying to yourselves 😤
sources: Schoenfeld BJ et al. Longer interset rest periods enhance muscle strength and hypertrophy in resistance-trained men. J Strength Cond Res 2016;30:1805-1812 (21 men, 8 weeks, 3 min vs 1 min)
